main:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Reads N and N integers via Z(), sorts them, computes two greedy difference-accumulation scores under two different initial pointer orders, and prints the larger score." main]
    [INPUTS]
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Call Z() to read integer N, and initialize A as an empty list. RESULT N]
            [COMMAND For each of the N repetitions, call Z(), append the returned value to A, then after the loop sort A in ascending order. RESULT A]
            [COMMAND Initialize used to a list of N zeros, output1 and output2 to 0, i1 and i2 to 0, j1 to N-1, j2 to N-2, and f1/f2 to True. Set used[0], used[N-2], and used[N-1] to 1, with used[0] written twice. RESULT used]
            [COMMAND While f1 or f2 is True: if f1 is True add A[j1]-A[i1] to output1; if f2 is True add A[j2]-A[i2] to output1. RESULT output1]
            [COMMAND In the same first outer loop, for i1 then i2, while the current i pointer is used, if it is N-1 set the corresponding flag to False and break, otherwise increment it; after the scan, mark the resulting index as used. This advancement runs even for an inactive pointer. RESULT used]
            [COMMAND In the same first outer loop, if f1 is True add A[j1]-A[i1] to output1; if f2 is True add A[j2]-A[i2] to output1. RESULT output1]
            [COMMAND In the same first outer loop, for j1 then j2, while the current j pointer is used, if it is 0 set the corresponding flag to False and break, otherwise decrement it; after the scan, mark the resulting index as used. This advancement runs even for an inactive pointer. Continue the outer loop until both flags are False. RESULT used]
            [COMMAND Reset i1=0, i2=1, j1=N-1, j2=N-1, f1=True, f2=True, and create a fresh used list of N zeros. Set used[0], used[1], and used[N-1] to 1, with used[N-1] written twice. RESULT used]
            [COMMAND While f1 or f2 is True: if f1 is True add A[j1]-A[i1] to output2; if f2 is True add A[j2]-A[i2] to output2. RESULT output2]
            [COMMAND In the same second outer loop, for j1 then j2, while the current j pointer is used, if it is 0 set the corresponding flag to False and break, otherwise decrement it; after the scan, mark the resulting index as used. This advancement runs even for an inactive pointer. RESULT used]
            [COMMAND In the same second outer loop, if f1 is True add A[j1]-A[i1] to output2; if f2 is True add A[j2]-A[i2] to output2. RESULT output2]
            [COMMAND In the same second outer loop, for i1 then i2, while the current i pointer is used, if it is N-1 set the corresponding flag to False and break, otherwise increment it; after the scan, mark the resulting index as used. This advancement runs even for an inactive pointer. Continue the outer loop until both flags are False. RESULT used]
            [COMMAND Print max(output1, output2). RESULT max_output]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
